tuner_timing.justification: Exploring lower latency and wakeup granularities to reduce p99 latency. Testing a more aggressive C-state (C1) and reduced perf percentages to potentially improve responsiveness. Increased busy poll slightly.

The previous iteration showed increased latency, possibly due to aggressive C-state (C1) and performance capping. We will slightly relax these, explore a middle ground for scheduler parameters, and test a less aggressive C-state (C1E) to balance latency and power.
